differences.what: Overall lighting is cold, flat blue-navy ambient with no warm key light; the reference is dominated by amber/orange glow from heaters, lanterns, string bulbs, candles and lit windows, with deep shadows between pools of light.
differences.where: Whole frame, especially the deck, railings and tables center
differences.fix: Drop the blue ambient to near-black, add warm (~2200-2700K) point lights at each heater, lantern, candle and bulb, enable bloom and filmic tonemapping so highlights glow and the deck reads as amber pools against darkness.

differences.what: No pergola/roof structure: the capture is open sky with rain falling directly onto the tables. The reference has a dark timber pergola with heavy posts and cross beams under a wet glass roof streaked with rain and lined with cyan LED edge strips.
differences.where: Top half of frame, left and right edges (posts)
differences.fix: Add dark-stained timber posts every ~2 m along both railings, longitudinal and cross beams overhead, and a transparent glass roof with water-streak normal map and droplets; rain should fall outside the roof and run off its edges as dripping curtains, not inside onto the tables.

differences.what: Railings are flat untextured gray/lavender panels; the reference has dark-brown vertical wood slat railings topped with long planter boxes overflowing with trailing ivy, purple wisteria and pink/white flowers, lit from below by warm uplights.
differences.where: Left and right midground, full length of the walkway
differences.fix: Replace panels with vertical wood-slat fences (dark walnut, visible grain), add planter boxes on top with dense trailing ivy cards, hanging purple wisteria clusters on the left, small warm uplights at the base of plants.

differences.what: Patio heaters are low-poly flat orange/beige cylinders with no emission; reference heaters are polished copper with a hot glowing orange mesh core, a reflective dome hat and strong warm light spill.
differences.where: Right side, two heaters (one near camera far right, one center-right)
differences.fix: Model tall copper heaters with conical copper reflector hats, a cylindrical wire-mesh emitter section that glows bright orange (emissive + bloom), metallic copper PBR with sharp reflections, and a warm point light at each; pull the foreground heater back so it doesn't fill the right edge.

differences.what: Deck floor is a flat matte dark navy plane with no wetness; reference deck is dark wood planks soaked and mirror-glossy, with long streaked reflections of the heaters, candles and bulbs.
differences.where: Bottom center foreground through midground floor
differences.fix: Use dark wood plank albedo with low roughness (0.05-0.15) in puddled areas, SSR/planar reflections, puddle masks and ripple normals so every warm light source produces a vertical streak reflection on the floor.

differences.what: Tables are bare, flat orange low-poly octagons with a single cup; reference has 3-4 round tables with glossy wet wood/stone tops, each set with a glowing candle votive, menu card stand, ceramic cup with steam, and small vases of pink flowers.
differences.where: Center, the table row receding down the walkway
differences.fix: Increase to 4 tables in a line, use round high-segment tops with warm reflective finish and black pedestal bases, add candle holders (emissive flame + light), table menu cards with 雫 logo, steaming cups, bud vases with pink flowers.

differences.what: Missing paper lanterns: reference has white chochin lanterns with a water-drop (雫) logo hanging from the left posts, glowing warm.
differences.fix: Hang 3-4 white paper lanterns with drop-and-wave emblem from the left pergola posts at decreasing distance, emissive warm interior with soft light falloff.

differences.what: String lights are large matte pastel balls, sparse and swooping on a single cable in open air; reference has many small, bright, emissive warm-white bulbs (with occasional pink/teal) strung in zigzags under the roof beams down the whole length.
differences.fix: Shrink bulbs to small Edison-style globes, make them emissive with bloom, mostly warm white/amber with a few pink, red and teal accents, and string them in multiple runs between beams receding to the vanishing point.

differences.what: Right side lacks bamboo, the 関係者以外立入禁止 sign, and the stone lantern; capture shows an empty pinkish wall slab and orange box.
differences.fix: Add a tall glowing bamboo planter along the right wall, a dark metal plaque reading 関係者以外 立入禁止 on the wooden wall, and a small stone/iron lantern with warm glow at the bottom-right corner on a stone step; remove the pink slab and orange block.

differences.what: Background buildings are dark blue blocks with blank/unlit windows and no signage; reference buildings have many warm-lit windows with curtains, balconies, AC units, a pink neon 雫テラス sign top right, a red やきとり sign lower left and cyan neon strips.
differences.fix: Light 50-70% of windows with warm interior emissive and curtain textures, add balcony railings, put a pink neon 雫テラス sign with drop icon at top right, a red illuminated やきとり sign at left behind the railing, and cyan neon strips along building ledges; add faint rain-haze fog in depth.
